brief: Carries a value between the stages of a flow together with its provenance, certainty, cost and content key.
detail: A parcel is the only thing that passes between stages. It has no public setter: the library fills its evidence, provenance and cost when a faculty runs, so it can be read and replayed but not edited. A stage yields either a parcel its court accepted or a refusal parcel whose value is the list of findings, which is why a refusal can travel through a flow like any other value. Certainty and probability are what the implementation stated, and unknown when it stated none; they are not a judgment made by a person.
example: #--> REFUSED: my-rule at stage x: something failed
